title: Planet Tweaks V3.5.3 - Zero-Alloc Keyboard Remapper Overhaul, Native Wi-Fi Channel Scanner, UI/Hit-Test Fixes & Tweak Catalog Hardening
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.5.3 (2026-11-22): (1) Keyboard Manager Engine Overhaul: Rebuilt hook hot path with zero-allocation VK/scancode lookup, prebuilt Win32 INPUT buffers, per-VK ownership/dispatch serialization, fail-open SendInput error handling, bounded key-up retry + exhaustion visibility, fail-closed hook teardown gate, physical-held key awareness through recovery, per-VK serialized Snap Tap batching, and honest hook diagnostics. (2) Native Wi-Fi Channel Scanner & Unified Hubs: Added real Windows wlanapi.dll Wi-Fi Neighbor & Best Channel Scanner inside a unified Network Hub (Network Tweaks | Wi-Fi Channel Scanner | DNS Optimizer | GeForce NOW & Cloud), unified Debloat Hub, flat Esports & Media Hub (removed nested sidebar dropdown), safe Quick Safe Boost routing, and removed duplicate profile pill. (3) Full UI, Auth & Tweak Catalog Fixes: Fixed folded sidebar & fullscreen modal hit-testing (WindowChrome.IsHitTestVisibleInChrome), rounded pill button hover overlays, login.html Supabase script collision, Private edition data isolation, P0 AMD thermal protection removal, 13 removed fake/broken tweaks, /QH powercfg detectors, transactional snapshot-before-mutate Undo hardening, and stripped all stale branding & control-char mojibake.
